autoPolicy.title: Automatic approval
autoPolicy.intro: Decide which entries may take effect without your review. Everything else waits for approval. Only applies to agents whose memory is set to "Automatic (workspace rules)".
autoPolicy.matrixCaption: Automatic approval by kind and source

origin.external_content: From a web page, file or tool

locked.inferred: Inferences can be wrong even when they sound plausible. A person sees them first.
locked.external_content: External content can contain instructions that look like facts. So never automatic.
locked.instruction: Entries in the "instruction" category tell the agent how to work. We treat that like a behavior change.
locked.agent_note: Notes about tools and environment steer how the agent works. We treat that like a behavior change.
locked.proposal: A proposal to change approved content always needs a person – otherwise an agent could quietly overwrite what was reviewed.
locked.lesson: Lesson suggestions never flow into a prompt. They are counted and can become a new version through a case, a test case and your approval.
locked.generic: The server never approves this combination automatically.

autoPolicy.humanChannel: Anything a person enters themselves counts as confirmed right away.
autoPolicy.expiry: Unconfirmed entries expire after {{days}} days. Retrievals don't extend that.
autoPolicy.legacyAuto: Agents set to "Automatic" only approve what is turned on here. While everything is off, every entry goes to "Awaiting approval".
autoPolicy.lastWeek: Last 7 days: {{auto}} approved automatically · {{confirmed}} of them confirmed

guardOff.title: The memory guard is off.
guardOff.description: Automatically approved entries are then not checked for instruction patterns.

autoPolicy.toastOn: Applies to new entries from now on. What's already waiting stays in the queue.
autoPolicy.toastOff: Automatic approval off. New entries wait for approval again.
autoPolicy.loadError: The setting could not be loaded.
autoPolicy.saveError: The setting could not be saved.
autoPolicy.humanOnly: Can only be changed with a real sign-in.

limits.disclosure: What automatic approval doesn't catch (8 points)
limits.title: Turn on automatic approval?
limits.intro: Entries of this kind then take effect right away, without anyone reading them. The filters keep running – but they don't catch everything:

instructionData.title: A sentence can be a fact and an instruction at once.
instructionData.body: "Lutz likes short answers" is both. No check separates the two reliably.

adaptiveAttacks.title: Targeted attacks get past filters.
adaptiveAttacks.body: In measurements, checks and protective framing were bypassed by targeted attacks, including by people.

contextual.title: Some entries only act in a particular situation.
contextual.body: On their own they look harmless and only stand out once they take effect.

plausible.title: Plausible isn't the same as correct.
plausible.body: "You prefer provider X" can be wrong, and no filter notices.

userSource.title: Even what you said yourself can be outdated or a slip.

selfReinforcing.title: Mistakes can reinforce themselves.
selfReinforcing.body: An agent building on a wrong entry produces more that fit it. Memory can also reinforce the agent telling you what you want to hear.

drift.title: Many small entries can slowly shift direction.
drift.body: Each one on its own is unremarkable.

rollbackLate.title: Pulling back only helps once someone notices.
rollbackLate.body: What the agent did until then stays done.

limits.stillHappens: What still happens: the filter checks every entry while it is turned on. The source is recorded. Every step is in the history. Unconfirmed entries expire after {{days}} days.
limits.pullbackAll: You can pull back everything approved automatically in one go.
limits.checkbox: I've read what automatic approval doesn't catch.
limits.confirmHint: Please confirm first that you have read the list.
